system.recommendation: Grader review by a person (factory/bin/eval is protected). In job 004 the approver read every job file, all round-2 files, the round-1 reviews, the diff and re-ran checks.sh through shell globs (for f in "$J"/*.md; for f in "$J"/round-2/*.md), but evidence_reread and grounding scored 33.3 because the rules match literal file names in tool inputs and do not expand globs. Same family as the c001 note on paths_verified and the OBSERVABLE regex (behavioural_criteria 42.9 for observable criteria). atomic_requirements also counts 'and' inside a list of nouns as a bundle.

Still open from c001: install agent-browser on the factory machine or make /factory health report it missing. In job 004 the builder, both UI reviews and the UX review each wrote their own headless Chrome CDP script, which costs tokens every run. If it won't be installed, a shared CDP helper script in the factory (written by a person) would remove that work.
